key_concepts: Household electrical energy consumption is measured in kilowatt-hours
Electrical energy consumption is calculated by multiplying power rating by usage time
Monthly electric bills reflect total household electrical power consumption
Different appliances have different power ratings and usage times
Reducing hours of use of high-power appliances can lower electrical consumption
Alternative energy sources such as solar power can supply household electricity
Energy-saving appliances have features that reduce electricity use
Simple actions at home can save electrical energy and reduce environmental impact
Comparing household consumption helps identify differences in energy use
Alternative energy systems convert another form of energy into electrical energy
Information campaigns can promote awareness of energy-saving actions
